content.short: Tokenized asset-backed finance, plus a savings app paying 3% on dollar balances.
content.description: Craftt opens up asset-backed finance, lending secured on consumer credit receivables, to more investors. Its tokenized pool funds overcollateralized facilities for fintech lenders, with institutional due diligence and reporting. For individuals, the Craftt Pass app pays around 3% on balances, accrued daily, and moves money in USD, EUR or stablecoins. It is backed by Superscrypt and DCG.
content.meta: Craftt tokenizes asset-backed consumer lending for investors and runs Craftt Pass, a savings app paying daily interest.
